question: Что такое HTTP/HTTPS and TLS basics и как это работает?
short_answer: HTTPS is HTTP carried through TLS, providing encryption in transit, integrity and server authentication through certificates.
junior_answer: HTTPS is HTTP carried through TLS, providing encryption in transit, integrity and server authentication through certificates. A TLS handshake negotiates keys and verifies the certificate chain; a reverse proxy may terminate TLS before forwarding to the app on a trusted network. Важное ограничение: HTTPS does not validate business permissions or encrypt data at rest.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с HTTP/HTTPS and TLS basics?
follow_up_answer: Trusting forwarded scheme/client headers from arbitrary peers can make an app believe an insecure request was HTTPS.
